metadata.description: clawdline: an animated Clawd, GitHub / GitLab CI status and quota pace in your Claude Code status bar

plugins.name: clawdline
plugins.description: Three-line status bar: Clawd reacts to what Claude is doing, your GitHub PR or GitLab MR shows with its live CI status, and context / 5h / 7d gauges tell you how fast you burn your quota. Run /clawdline:setup after installing.
